notes:
- Added Social settings category
- Added option to close the chat input box upon sending a message
- Added option to enable missing slash commands in chat
- Added new chat commands: "/w \<target>" (whisper player), "/invite \<target>" (invite player to party), "/leave" (leave party)
- Added Friend Notes, used by clicking the settings button on a friend in the friend list. Setting a note displays it next to their name in the friend list.
- Added option to hide friend connection/disconnection system messages
